summary.purpose: Citation-only correction; no new textual correction, changed reading, renumbered entry, or changed review cohort.
summary.source_record_indexing: FIXLOG references count JSONL records from 1; MISPRINTS references use the existing zero-based array indices. Editorial patches are identified by their exact decision ID.
summary.offset_convention: Zero-based half-open character spans in the exact cleaned witness projections used by french.py (source comments removed; folio furniture replaced by SGApage anchors).
summary.method: Same volume, file where recorded, and folio. Exact full quotations must place the hunk inside their actual old/new changed spans; alternatively an identical recorded changed atom must be unique among actual same-page hunks and have a surviving full-quotation anchor at that exact span. Every surviving quote must be consistent with the hunk. No nearby-context or quote-length scoring and no unanchored atom inference.
summary.limits: Records using paraphrase, composite quotations, or surrounding text changed independently may fail this conservative exact check. A WITNESS identifier records that the paired designated witnesses support the existing reading, while the earlier individual historical citation is not established. It is a metadata fallback, not an emendation or a new ADOPT decision.
